svg.title: Vessel track layouts · synthetic sample — not a measurement
svg.desc: Three separate vessel panels retain their own metre axes, start points, gridlines, scale bars and legends. Each has a solid reference track and eight labelled, differently dashed sensor tracks; the synthetic paths illustrate the reading layout, not positioning results.
svg.text: Synthetic sample — not a measurement; illustrates the vessel-track layout.
Read each panel’s metre axes separately; panel scales differ.
